text: Scope addition proposed 2026-11-16 (plan section "Measurement and projection contract", branch claude/plan-measurement-contract-20261116 @eaea4c207, bead bd-01M7JCDMCX9H2BK6X17PRN3GHQ). Proposal only; the owner decides. The ADR should reconcile with ADRs 0019 (2026-10-11 extension) and 0022, which already decide A-or-B vs A-and-B, empirical response frequencies with denominators, onset vs duration and typed unavailable allocation, and decide only what the contract adds: (1) joint and broad reference as recorded meanings at a declared source grain, for units and detail atoms; (2) feature targets for recall units, atoms and source rows, and their placement (features depends only on core; MeasureKind is in align); (3) a level-holding allocation beside the existing mass-distributing ones; (4) whether an empirical response frequency becomes a named MeasureKind. Rejected alternative to record: one normalized probability vector over single source units as the mapping record. Self-reported confidence stays a separate observation, never a raw score or decision basis.
